authority.allowed_inputs: Pinned local SWE-bench Verified parquet, the three already-opened official result blobs, and the existing pinned local embedding artifact.
authority.implementation_scope: One direct experiment-layer replay and focused tests; no core records, training service, registry, or Runner changes.

source_results.outcome_status: All target outcomes were open before this plan. Results can screen mechanisms and nominate at most one independent test; they cannot confirm an algorithm.

research_contract.target: Find a simple, outcome-safe mechanism that predicts a target repository's next five-Task Agent pass-rate vector well enough that a ten-Task local historical subset improves future-pass-rate MAE over all eligible local history.
research_contract.primary_baseline: All eligible historical Tasks from the target repository.
research_contract.primary_estimand: Repository-equal mean candidate-minus-full-history MAE over the seven-repository wide portfolio.
research_contract.primary_loss: Mean absolute selected-history versus next-five-Task pass-rate error over the frozen three-Agent panel.
research_contract.deployment_boundary: At a target Origin, every candidate selects only that repository's eligible historical Tasks. Cross-repository fitting may use complete non-target research repositories but never target future outcomes.
non_solutions: changing a window, embedding model, shrinkage coefficient, or mixture weight after observing candidate results
relabeling a failed existing rule without a new predictive mechanism
using target future Task text or outcomes during forecasting or Selection
mixing Tasks from several repositories into one candidate pool
optimizing semantic distance and reporting it as Agent-outcome validity
promoting a Runner default or widening core train_selector from opened development outcomes

rolling_origin.complete_trailing_block_rule: Partition backward from the latest history Task into non-overlapping five-Task blocks; ignore only the leading 0-4 Task remainder for block-state estimation.

outer_evaluation.fold: Hold out one complete target repository. Any cross-repository fit uses the other six repositories with equal total repository weight.
outer_evaluation.repository_weighting: Origins equal within repository; repositories equal in the macro result.

candidates.thesis: The coordinate-wise median of complete historical block pass rates estimates a typical current regime while resisting one stale or anomalous block.
candidates.forecast: For each Agent, take the ordinary median of all complete trailing five-Task block pass rates.
candidates.selection: Use the deterministic outcome-vector dynamic program to choose ten historical Tasks matching the forecast.
candidates.decisive_ablation: history_match targets the full-history mean instead of the robust block median.

candidates.thesis: The next cohort depends on transitions among joint Agent-response states, which scalar mean drift discards.
candidates.forecast: Encode every Task as one binary joint-Agent state. Average symmetric-Dirichlet-smoothed transition rows across the six training repositories, use that matrix as an eight-pseudotransition prior for target-local historical transitions, then average the one- through five-step predictive Agent rates from the latest local state.
candidates.selection: Use the deterministic outcome-vector dynamic program to choose ten local historical Tasks matching the forecast.
candidates.fitting: Outer-training repositories only; target-local transition counts stop at the Origin.
candidates.decisive_ablation: joint_markov_global_match omits target-local transition counts while keeping the same training repositories and forecast.

candidates.thesis: Future drift transfers only between repositories in similar response regimes, so unconditional repository-mean drift averages away the signal.
candidates.forecast: Describe each Origin by full-history, penultimate-block, and latest-block Agent pass rates. Choose the nearest Origin separately inside each training repository, take the coordinate-wise median of its future-minus-latest residuals, and add that residual to the target latest-block rates with [0,1] clipping.
candidates.selection: Use the deterministic outcome-vector dynamic program to choose ten local historical Tasks matching the forecast.
candidates.fitting: Outer-training repositories only; equal one-analog contribution per training repository; mean absolute state distance and origin_id tie break.
candidates.decisive_ablation: cross_repository_drift_match is the already-recorded unconditional residual-transfer control.

candidates.thesis: A repository's problem-text distribution moves over time, and extrapolating that movement identifies historical Tasks resembling the next cohort better than targeting a static recent centroid.
candidates.forecast: Compute one embedding centroid per complete trailing five-Task block. Fit an unregularized per-dimension line over all block indices and extrapolate the next block centroid.
candidates.selection: Greedily minimize squared distance between the selected ten-Task embedding mean and the forecast centroid, then apply at most twenty deterministic improving one-for-one swaps.
candidates.fitting: Target-local historical embeddings only; no Agent outcome enters Selection.
candidates.decisive_ablation: centroid_recent_15 is the already-recorded static semantic-target control.

diagnostics.forecast_decomposition: For outcome-rate candidates, report forecast-versus-future MAE and selected-versus-forecast MAE separately from the primary selected-versus-future MAE.
diagnostics.semantic_alignment: Report selected-versus-future embedding-centroid distance as a mechanism diagnostic only.

nomination_rule.effect: At most one primary candidate, ordered by wide macro loss then selector_id, may be frozen for an independent test. Production promotion is forbidden.
requirements: wide macro-repository difference is at most -0.01
at least five of seven repositories have negative difference
every wide leave-one-repository-out summary is negative
candidate is better than at least 75 percent of equal-budget random draws
an Agent-outcome forecast candidate improves the fixed history_match compression control

failure_model: a target future outcome or Task embedding enters forecasting before Selection freezes
Django's 43 Origins dominate a pooled objective
an outer target repository enters analog or Markov fitting
the response forecast improves but the ten-Task subset cannot represent it
subset matching improves on the reference panel but has inconsistent per-Agent direction
semantic extrapolation lowers embedding distance without lowering Agent-outcome MAE
a favorable macro result reverses when one repository cluster is removed
candidate choice is made from post-result parameter variants

background_sources.role: standard analog-forecasting mechanism, not a Barcarolle result
standard Dirichlet treatment of categorical transition rows, not a Barcarolle result
robust block aggregation background, not a Barcarolle result
greedy convex projection and kernel-herding background, not a Barcarolle result
